sam: quick update  ran a late-bind-prefetch canary on a tiny ded pool this morning. short summary below. :sparkles:

ishaan: TL;DR?

sam: median -20%, p95 -5%, p99 flat, token-cost -29% on generation-heavy tests. throughput +16%.

clare: bench paste + flags pls.

sam: CANARY - 2026-03-26 10:10 UTC
Model: rw-7b-econ
Profile: 80% gen, 20% chat
Baseline: p50=75ms p95=220ms p99=340ms tokens/s=900 cost=$0.0123/1k
Canary (late-bind-prefetch): p50=60ms p95=209ms p99=341ms tokens/s=1044 cost=$0.00873/1k
Delta: p50 -20.0% p95 -5.0% p99 +0.3% throughput +16.0% unit-cost -29.1%
Flags: late_bind_prefetch=true, bind.window=6, seq_gate=2700

infra-bot: health: errors 0.10% (down), mem stable, all checks green.

ishaan: any regression risk? long sequences?

sam: long>2700 show slight mem jitter; gating seq_len>2700. also added quality check on eval set B, drift <0.2%.

ops-bot: ticket INF-5012 created: "Expose late-bind-prefetch savings in Console" assigned to clare. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5012

clare: will prototype a small savings card on the model dashboard (1d).

ishaan: rollout plan?

sam: expand to 30% tonight, 70% tomorrow AM if stable, GA after 12h stable. rollback via flag flip or console toggle. curl to disable: 

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/flags \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \n  -d '{"pool":"gd-dedicated-small","flags":{"late_bind_prefetch":false}}'
```

clare: adding alerts for p95 regressions and seq_len regressions (15min window). dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/late-bind-3049998888

sam: will post a short blurb to #releases after 70% stability. :thumbsup:
